notes.content:
[h2] For all of the fans of exploring vast galaxies we have a great news! Cat's Cosmic Atlas appears in Steam Space Exploration Fest! You can now grab the game with 80% off discount! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361235/20fc8d977bbd56249bfba794b51c336613647165.jpg[/img]

Learning more about the galaxy in Cat’s Cosmic Atlas! 🪐

Once upon a time a curious kitten called Fellie really wanted to explore the night sky above. She took her lovely journal with her and proceeded to write down everything that she came upon during her space travels.
Together with her, players will have a chance to go on a journey around the sun while learning more about stars, asteroids, planets, constellations, and their history.

Cat’s Cosmic Atlas lets players discover new things at their own pace and without stressing about progress. Additionally, there is a button dedicated to petting Fellie. That’s a very important button.

notes.title: RedDeer.Games presents a new, cozy, puzzle game - Tell Me Your Story 📖
notes.content:
[h3][b]RedDeer.Games announces developement of a new in house game - [i]Tell Me Your Story[/i] - proposition for every fan of story-driven, cozy & puzzle games! [/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/9740fd7b2d093f1a8556098e40c9e72dc7fbff67.jpg[/img]

Amelia comes to her grandma's cottage for the summer, expecting to spend the warm months there knitting, gardening, and helping her out. Soon enough, the girl realizes that her grandma Rose's house is full of wonders, artifacts, and souvenirs from all around the world. 

And so begins a journey to the past via the tales and memories of a retired globetrotter – a side of Amelia’s grandma, that she had no idea about.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/5a0570940adae65b57d63025550b2a9dbeed5c45.jpg[/img]

In Tell Me Your Story, the players, together with Amelia, will be tasked with helping the elderly woman with everyday chores – that is until they will find a couple of interesting artifacts. 

This discovery will turn the summer vacation around and Rose's adventurous past will be unearthed in the form of colorful memories.

To follow the story, the players will solve region-themed puzzles, surrounded by the hand-drawn scenery. There will be over 70 different types of riddles, neatly separated into 3 chapters related to Rose’s travels. Visiting South America's rainforests, the Chinese province of Yunnan, and the track of Orient Express' first route – that’s what players can expect.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/3f66393b0ce00aee6bc61123985dcbc72e205ea4.jpg[/img]

Tell Me Your Story has eye-catching and cozy visuals, that fit perfectly with the theme of getting to know the past of one's family. Those tales will be powered by Amelia's vivid imagination – which conveys the wordless game’s story perfectly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/bdafd80507fdf0732489c23bdcd9e671afc91026.gif[/img]
[h2]Tell Me Your Story will be available on Steam and Nintendo Switch in 2024

You can wishlist the game now! 
[/h2] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415570/Tell_me_your_story/?beta=0

notes.title: Let's learn about star constellations together
notes.content:
[h2]Learn more with Cat's Cosmic Atlas[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361235/c3fe107fdcdb7f4a662f2e79040b57fb1e00d5d2.jpg[/img]

In [b]Cat's Cosmic Atlas[/b], the celestial wonders of constellations await your exploration! Delve into the captivating world of stars and constellations, where the night sky becomes your interactive playground. As you journey through the Southern and Northern skies, you will encounter various legendary constellations steeped in mythology and history. Learn about the fascinating stories behind each constellation and how ancient civilizations perceived these star patterns. From Orion's Belt to the Big Dipper, each constellation has its unique tale to tell. The game seamlessly weaves educational values into the experience, allowing you to expand your knowledge about the cosmos while being enchanted by the whimsical picture book aesthetic

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361235/fc3edacfd0848f2a2de39d0d6b8ff60454ca10ea.gif[/img]

Get ready to embark on an interactive learning experience as you master the art of celestial navigation in [b]Cat's Cosmic Atlas[/b]. While strolling along the night sky, you'll not only marvel at the sheer beauty of the stars but also gain a deeper understanding of their positions and significance. Earn badges as you successfully identify constellations, connecting the stars to form these captivating patterns. The game encourages nonlinear exploration, giving you the freedom to choose your preferred route through the Solar System or along the Northern and Southern skies. Whether you're a seasoned stargazer or a curious novice, "Cat's Cosmic Atlas" offers a delightful journey that combines education and entertainment, leaving you with a profound appreciation for the wonders of the Universe.

notes.title: Story of a little kitty
notes.content:
[h2]Hello players, the Cat's Cosmic Atlas adventure begins![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361235/1cc716a35fadb43ba4e0c507239ce87ceb77ea1f.jpg[/img]

Greetings, cosmic travelers! We are incredibly excited to share the first devlog of our game 
[b]Cat's Cosmic Atlas[/b] with all of you! Embark on an unforgettable journey through the night sky as an adorable kitten, where the magic of stars intertwines with fascinating knowledge about the Universe. Our game offers an interactive adventure that will transport you to a fairy-tale world inspired by classic children's literature. Let yourselves be captivated by beautiful illustrations and soothing music that accompany you every step of the way. Explore the secrets of the cosmos, earn badges for your discoveries, and nurture the hearts of both the curious explorer and animal lover within you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361235/d6c9d59344964eaf2be70d85c75fc9010eabd2f1.gif[/img]

Have you ever wondered what it's like to be a little kitten with an insatiable curiosity for the mysteries of the universe? [b]Cat's Cosmic Atlas[/b] lets you step into the paws of an adorable feline eager to uncover the unknown. Discover cosmic secrets, admire the beauty of stars and planets, all in the magical form of an interactive picture book. Expand your knowledge about other worlds and stars while having fun, and realize that education can be an enjoyable experience. Immerse yourself in this enchanting journey, leaving behind the worries of everyday life, and rest assured that in this delightful story, numerous surprises and fascinating discoveries await!

notes.title: Cat's Cosmic Atlas takes part in the Wholesome Games festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/b73a1c15428b5afaef0e90cac3d93d411067951b.png[/img]
[h2]Check out Cat's Cosmic Atlas now during the Wholesome Games Festival![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361235/8c87c80fbc72ed96fe92c3bc512cf56573bb070a.jpg[/img]

"[b]Wholesome Games[/b] is a video game curation community with over 500,000 members across social media platforms. The community is best known for Wholesome Direct, a popular showcase of uplifting and thoughtful indie games.

One of the goals of Wholesome Games is to change how we think about which games are taken seriously. For many years, the most critically acclaimed titles have been the ones with the darkest themes and grimmest depictions of life, but there's also a whole world of hopeful video games with rich storytelling, innovative gameplay, and beautiful art and sound. We want to be a part of showcasing the breadth of experiences that games can have for players.

Wholesome Direct is an independent showcase organized by Wholesome Games. Each year the showcase features a selection of indie games that demonstrate the incredible range of themes, styles, and perspectives that games have to offer. Wholesome Direct 2023 will be streamed live on Saturday, June 10 at 9 AM PT via YouTube and Twitch."
